verifiedSurfaceSummary: The current official careers page declares unique public Reczee roles in its own tenant. Its actually declared public client is inspected as program data and never executed; its anonymous native job-data GET supplies full criteria and current careers publication. Role metadata, whole API models, literal role/API countries, native posting IDs, timestamps, employment, application screening/video requirements and both original observations remain retained. Corporate, public and internal titles stay distinct. Formal requisitions, legal employer, first-ever publication and application availability remain unknown where not disclosed. Public role-page reads do not constitute form interaction. Company/listing totals and cleanup remain unqualified; anonymous bounded reads stop on first failure.
